info.name: Detective Quiz - Week 11
info.description:
Week 11 evidence: Hub Contract, question sets CRUD (Module 1), sessions and joining (Module 2).
Run `npm run db:reset`, start the API, then run the whole collection in order.

exec: pm.test("body is JSON", function () { pm.expect(typeof pm.response.json()).to.eql("object"); });
pm.test("body is JSON", function () { pm.expect(typeof pm.response.json()).to.eql("object"); });

item.name: GET /results without the Hub key answers 401
GET /results with the Hub key answers 200

exec: pm.test("body is JSON", function () { pm.expect(typeof pm.response.json()).to.eql("object"); });

item.name: 403 a player cannot list question sets
201 host creates a set (client sends host_id 99)

exec: pm.test("host_id is the caller, not 99", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().host_id).to.not.eql(99); });

item.name: 409 same title again by the same host

exec: pm.test("body is an array containing my set", function () { var ids = pm.response.json().map(function (s) { return s.id; }); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("setId")); });

item.name: 400 the id is not a number
401 create a game without the header
403 a player cannot create a game
201 host creates a game (client sends its own code)

exec: pm.test("code is 6 digits, server-made", function () { var c = pm.response.json().code; pm.expect(/^[1-9][0-9]{5}$/.test(c)).to.be.true; pm.expect(c).to.not.eql("111111"); });

item.name: 400 the code is not six digits
200 the same player rejoins, same seat

exec: pm.test("rejoined with the same seat", function () { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.rejoined).to.be.true; pm.expect(b.player_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("playerId")); });

item.name: 409 nickname already taken by another player

exec: pm.test("the player is in the list", function () { var names = pm.response.json().map(function (p) { return p.nickname; }); pm.expect(names).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("nick")); });

item.name: 403 a player cannot change the status
409 a new player cannot join after the start
200 the seated player rejoins the RUNNING game
409 one game at a time (player is still RUNNING)

exec: pm.test("the closed game is in the results", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("code")); });
